summary: Closure review: the authors addressed many prior concerns and supplied complete, auditable artifacts showing a preregistered paired confirmatory run. Two prior required items remain unresolved in the manuscript text and must be added from archived artifacts before finalisation: (1) an aggregate count of difficulty labels across the 200 confirmatory intents with artifact SHA-256 citation, and (2) an auditable exemplar description of the single repaired episode (task id, validator.violation_codes, deterministic repair rule applied, and before/after normalized_configuration or artifact paths+SHA). Other aspects (preregistration fidelity, archival reproducibility, exact-test choice, and accounting) are satisfactory. Accept_for_finalisation=false.
critical_issues: Manuscript does not include an aggregate summary (counts) of task difficulty labels across the 200 confirmatory intents; this summary is required to interpret the difficulty distribution of the curated bank and is available in the archived execution/task_manifest.jsonl.

Manuscript omits an auditable, inline exemplar report for the single repaired episode: the task identifier, validator.violation_codes, which canonical deterministic repair transformation (insertion/reordering/preservation) was applied, and a before/after normalized_configuration snippet or explicit artifact paths with SHA-256. This detail is necessary to substantiate the claimed single repair yield.
required_revisions: Insert a one-paragraph aggregate difficulty-summary (counts of easy/medium/hard/very_hard or equivalent labels) for the 200 confirmatory intents, extracted from execution/task_manifest.jsonl, and cite the manifest SHA-256 (existing artifact: execution/task_manifest.jsonl, SHA-256 eb2f045f8a6214eb6d814e16f5d95e0120bd89973951b6fe14084bda4e3efb4a).

Add a concise, auditable exemplar paragraph for the single repaired episode: report the task_id, the validator.violation_codes reported for validation_before, the deterministic repair rule name(s) applied (insertion/reordering/preservation), and either short before/after normalized_configuration snippets or the exact artifact paths and SHA-256 hashes pointing to the pre- and post-repair traces (these traces exist in the archived execution/scoring and repair-trace artifacts).
optional_revisions: Consider adding one short sentence in the Abstract that the confirmatory bank is synthetic/curated to improve scanning-reader clarity (artifact-backed detail is already in Limitations).
Optionally include a one-line labeled excerpt of the initial master prompt with its SHA-256 in the Disclosure Statement (or a clear pointer plus the SHA already present) if space permits.

Briefly (one paragraph) discuss expected yield/cost trade-offs for an independent-resampling estimand (2+ initial generations per intent) using the existing execution accounting to illustrate model-call cost scaling.
